task_completion.description: Navigate to the CRM Settings or Picklist Editor area.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Settings' menu or 'Picklist Editor' page open in the Vtiger CRM interface.

task_completion.description: Select the 'Leads' module within the Picklist Editor.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Select Module' dropdown or header should clearly show 'Leads' is selected.

task_completion.description: Add 'Social Media' and 'Referral Program' to the Lead Source field.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog box or list view showing 'Social Media' and 'Referral Program' being typed into or added to the 'Lead Source' picklist values.

task_completion.description: Add 'Landscaping Services' and 'Property Management' to the Industry field.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog box or list view showing 'Landscaping Services' and 'Property Management' being typed into or added to the 'Industry' picklist values.

task_completion.description: Save the changes and verify the new values appear in the picklist lists.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save' button click followed by a view of the updated picklist tables showing all four new values present in their respective fields.

integrity.description: The agent used the CRM web interface rather than executing SQL commands in a terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: The screenshots should show mouse movements and browser interactions with the Vtiger UI, not a command-line interface or database terminal.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the menu system rather than jumping directly to a deep-link URL if not provided.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the agent clicking through 'Settings' or 'Configuration' menus to reach the Picklist Editor.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered the values into the CRM fields.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the text being entered into the CRM's 'Add Value' text areas.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must add exactly these values to the Leads module: Lead Source field must include 'Social Media' and 'Referral Program'; Industry field must include 'Landscaping Services' and 'Property Management'. These values are case-sensitive and must be saved in the Vtiger CRM database via the GUI.
